h: Uniting Torah and Avodah Through the Sacred Census

p: וַיְדַבֵּר ה׳ אֶל מֹשֶׁה בְּמִדְבַּר סִינַי
"And Hashem spoke to Moshe in the Wilderness of Sinai,
בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (רֵישׁ פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, קיז, א)
In the holy Zohar (beginning of this parsha, III 117a):
Rather, one is for the Torah
and one is for the Mishkan."
This is the matter of the unification
of Kudsha Brich Hu and His Shechinah.
For Kudsha Brich Hu is called Torah
and the Mishkan is called the Shechinah:
אֲנִי ה׳ שֹׁכֵן בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל (בְּמִדְבַּר לה, לד)
"I, Hashem, dwell among the Bnei Yisrael" (Bamidbar 35:34).
And this sefer is called Chumash HaPekudim,
for its holiness lies in the countings.
And it is written, "You shall count them,
for Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
is the root of the words of Torah,
and Aharon is the root of the avodah,
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּמִּדְרָשׁ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה ג, ה)
And this is what they said in the Midrash (Bereishis Rabbah 3:5):
וַיַּבְדֵּל אֱלֹהִים בֵּין הָאוֹר וּבֵין הַחֹשֶׁךְ
"'And God separated between the light and the darkness'
between those who left Mitzrayim and those who entered the Land."
are those who received Torah she'bichsav,
Kudsha Brich Hu is called Torah,
are the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh,
"For from Tziyon shall go forth Torah,
and the word of Hashem from Yerushalayim";
דְּבַר ה׳ זוֹ הֲלָכָה (שַׁבָּת קלח, ב)
"the word of Hashem" — this is halachah (Shabbos 138b).
And this is the middah of day and the middah of night,
as is written in the Tanchuma (Ki Sisa 36)
when it was day and when it was night?
When HaKadosh Baruch Hu was teaching him
he knew that it was day;
and when He taught him Torah she'b'al peh,
he knew that it was night."
And this is the meaning of "between ... the darkness":
for about those occupied with Torah she'b'al peh
it is written, "The people who walk in darkness
וְכֵן עַל אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And likewise about Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
"'Let there be light' — this is Avraham";
for he was the first who learned Torah,
the two thousand years of Torah.
from Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
which is the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh.
And therefore the meal of Shabbos night
the holy Arizal, of blessed memory, arranged
to correspond to Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him.
And Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
those who left Mitzrayim and those who entered the Land.
שֶׁזֶּה הִכְנִיס מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל
For this is what Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him, brought into Yisrael,
"Moshe rejoiced in the gift of his portion,"
of Torah she'bichsav and Torah she'b'al peh,
as we mentioned from the Gemara and the holy Zohar.
And he brought into Yisrael the count
of the hosts of the Torah and the hosts of the Mishkan,
the unification of Kudsha Brich Hu and His Shechinah.

paragraphs.text: Source: Devarim 20:19 — “כי תצור אל עיר ימים רבים להלחם עליה לתפשה לא תשחית את עצה לנדח עליו גרזן כי ממנו תאכל ואתו לא תכרת כי האדם עץ השדה לבא מפניך במצור” — “When in your war against a city you have to besiege it a long time in order to capture it, you must not destroy its trees, wielding the ax against them. You may eat of them, but you must not …”

paragraphs.text: Source: Bereishis Rabbah 17:5 — “… כי נסך עליכם ה' רוח תרדמה. רבי חנינא בר יצחק אמר שלש נובלות הן, נובלת מיתה, שנה. נובלת נבואה, חלום. נובלת העולם הבא, שבת. רבי אבין מוסיף עוד תרתין, …” — ““The Lord God cast a deep slumber upon the man, and he slept. He took one of his sides, and He closed it with flesh in its place [taḥtena]” (Genesis 2:21). “The Lord God cast [hipil] a deep slumber” – Rabbi Yehoshua of Sikhnin said in the name of Rabbi Levi: The beginning of downfall [mapala] is sleep. When a person sleeps, he does not toil in Torah and does not do any work.15Too much sleep is a recipe for ruin. …”

paragraphs.text: Source: Shemos 31:16 — “ושמרו בני ישראל את השבת לעשות את השבת לדרתם ברית עולם” — “The Israelite people shall keep the sabbath, observing the sabbath throughout the ages as a covenant for all time:”

paragraphs.text: Source: Tikkunei Zohar 169:3 — “… טז) ושמרו בני ישראל את השבת לעשות את השבת וגומר, תרין זמנין אדכיר הכא שבת, לקבל שכינתא עלאה ותתאה, לדרתם מאי לדרתם, אלא זכאה איהו מאן דעביד לון דירה בשבת …”
